review.headline: Easy 9 km done at 5:46/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band and at a conversational heart rate.
observations: Distance 8.999 km against a 9.0 km plan, so the volume matched.
Average pace 5:46/km sits inside the easy band; every km split was 5:46 (345-346 s), showing very even pacing.
Average HR 139 (max 142), in line with the 4-week easy average of 140 and recent easy runs at 137-140.
Cadence 174 spm, consistent with recent easy runs.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so perceived effort is unconfirmed.
Week 3 completed only 3 of 7 sessions (24.8 km of 43.4 planned), and CTL has dropped 4.4 points over 7 days, so recent load is well below plan.
